# Independent Cargo JSONL artifact-list captures

`original.json` captures the unchanged inline Python command from the Radar ARM
workflow at commit `3f342cb6`. The captured program and its SHA-256 are included.
Python 3.12.15 ran each complete command against a separately written input file;
expected results were not generated by the Rust replacement.

The 57 cases cover eager JSONL parsing before selection, ordered duplicates,
Python truthiness and short-circuit lookup failures, selected-value string
requirements, missing keys, malformed input, UTF-8 and universal newlines,
Unicode and surrogateescape output paths, and the original decoder depth limit.
The 9,996 nested arrays inside an outer object are accepted; 9,997 are rejected.

The native command keeps the workflow's separate nonempty-file assertion. Empty
selection prints one newline, exactly as the original did. It does not enforce
an artifact count or add a new path-existence policy. The independent lazy
recovery artifact selector and other embedded Python commands remain pending.

Capture scripts and raw temporary input live only in the ignored directory
`.analysis/scratch/2026-10-16-ci-artifact-list/`. No interpreter is needed to run
the committed native tests or the replacement command.
